ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, these are two paper tapes recorded by a ticker timer when particles A and B make straight-line motion, and the time intervals between each counting point on the two paper tapes are all the same. Regarding the description of the motion conditions of the two particles, which of the following statements is correct? (　　)
A. The two particles have the same average velocity during the time $t_{0}\sim t_{4}$
B. The speeds of the two particles at time $t_{2}$ are equal in magnitude
C. The moment when the velocities of the two particles are equal is between $t_{3}\sim t_{4}$
D. The two particles do not necessarily start from the same place, but at time $t_{0}$ the velocity of A is 0

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, these are two paper tapes recorded by a ticker timer when particles A and B make straight-line motion, and the time intervals between each counting point on the two paper tapes are all the same. During the time t0~t4, what is the relationship between the average velocities of particles A and B?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper paper tape in the figure is labeled A, and the lower paper tape is labeled B. Both paper tapes are equipped with a scale from 0 to 10; on paper tape A, the t0 position is approximately at the 0 mark, and the t4 position is approximately at the 8 mark; on paper tape B, the t0 position is also approximately at the 0 mark, and the t4 position is approximately at the 8 mark. Therefore, from the figure, the differences between the initial and final scale readings corresponding to A and B from t0 to t4 are both approximately 8 units. Reasoning: The question stem states that the time intervals between each counting point on the two paper tapes are all the same. From t0 to t4 both include t0→t1, t1→t2, t2→t3, t3→t4, a total of 4 identical time intervals, so the total time experienced by A and B is the same. Average velocity equals displacement divided by time; within t0~t4, the two have the same displacement and the same time, so the average velocities are the same.
